title: Copy.ai: The only AI platform purpose-built for outcomes

facts.fact: Copy.ai's Growth plan, described as for businesses harnessing AI for exponential growth, is priced at $1,000 per month.
Copy.ai's Growth plan is billed annually at $12,000 per year.
Copy.ai's Growth plan includes 75 seats, unlimited words in chat, and 20K workflow credits per month.
facts.quote: 75 Seats Unlimited Words in Chat 20K Workflow Credits/Mo

facts.fact: Copy.ai's Expansion plan, for enterprises expanding their AI Automations, is priced at $2,000 per month.
Copy.ai's Expansion plan is billed annually at $24,000 per year.
Copy.ai's Expansion plan includes 150 seats, unlimited words in chat, and 45K workflow credits per month.
facts.quote: 150 Seats Unlimited Words in Chat 45K Workflow Credits/Mo

facts.fact: Copy.ai's Scale plan, for organizations ready to deploy Generative AI at scale, is priced at $3,000 per month.
Copy.ai's Scale plan is billed annually at $36,000 per year.
Copy.ai's Scale plan includes 200 seats, unlimited words in chat, and 75K workflow credits per month.
facts.quote: 200 Seats Unlimited Words in Chat 75K Workflow Credits/Mo

facts.fact: Copy.ai's Chat plan, for small teams starting to drive real business value with AI, includes 5 seats.
facts.quote: For small teams starting to drive real business value with AI 5 Seat

facts.fact: Copy.ai states that it has 17 million users at leading companies.
facts.quote: Trusted by **17 million** users at leading companies

facts.fact: Copy.ai's enterprise onboarding timeline lists a Day 1 kickoff, Week 1 testing, and Day 15 production day.
facts.quote: Timeline Overview: • Day 1: Kickoff • Week 1: Testing • Day 15: Production Day

facts.fact: According to Copy.ai's FAQ, a credit represents a specific amount of computational power necessary to execute the tasks within a given workflow.
facts.quote: A credit represents a specific amount of computational power necessary to execute the tasks within a given workflow

facts.fact: According to Copy.ai's FAQ, the cost of a workflow run in credits depends on its complexity, with more steps and content consuming more credits.
facts.quote: The more steps and content a workflow generates, the more it'll cost in credits.

facts.fact: Copy.ai's FAQ states that users can upgrade at any time and pay a prorated amount for the rest of the month.
facts.quote: If you choose to upgrade, you'll pay a prorated amount for the rest of the month.

facts.fact: Copy.ai's FAQ states that downgrades are credited on next month's bill.
facts.quote: If you choose to downgrade, you'll be credited on next month's bill.
